copyright_holder: No copyright line in LICENSE (unfilled Apache appendix placeholder). format: Claude Cowork/Code plugins: SKILL.md skills plus commands, .mcp.json connector configs, CONNECTORS.md per plugin
tool_dependencies: Skills are written tool-agnostic (CRM, email, calendar, chat, ledger, ticketing categories) and state a no-connector fallback (paste or upload). .mcp.json files reference Slack, Gmail, Notion, Atlassian, HubSpot, Asana, Linear, Intercom, Figma, Amplitude, Snowflake, BigQuery, Docusign, Clay, Similarweb, ZoomInfo, Zoho, Gusto, QuickBooks/Xero (small-business), and others.
paid_requirements: None required to read or adapt. Connected workflows assume paid SaaS (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, ZoomInfo, Gusto, QuickBooks, etc.). small-business tax-prep and payroll math are US-only by design.
quality_notes: Best business-function source assessed. Read legal/review-contract (358 lines: side-of-deal intake, playbook load, clause table, escalation triggers, not-legal-advice framing), sales/handle-objection (untrusted-content rules, grounding in win/loss data), customer-support/ticket-triage (P1-P4 taxonomy, routing), small-business/tax-prep (books-closed gate before any tax math, explicit US-only check, assumptions table), design/user-research (method table with sample sizes), human-resources/interview-prep (structured, scored). Treats emails/transcripts as data not instructions. Weaknesses: human-resources and some design/operations skills are short (30-40 lines) checklists; small-business tax and payroll are US federal only; root LICENSE file has a few lines of stray non-license text appended after the Apache appendix (plugin-level LICENSE copies are clean). No India content.
decision_reason: Apache-2.0, maintained by Anthropic, workflow-grade skills with gates, decision criteria and output templates across sales, CS, support, legal, finance, HR and ops, which are the departments other collections cover worst.

copyright_holder: No copyright line in LICENSE (unfilled Apache appendix placeholder). Repository owner is Anthropic. Contributions under CLA.md.
format: Claude plugins: SKILL.md skills grouped by practice area, plus agents/ and a cold-start interview that writes a practice profile
tool_dependencies: Optional connectors (ticketing, docs, CLM) described in CONNECTORS.md. Skills read and write a local practice profile under ~/.claude/plugins/config/claude-for-legal/.
paid_requirements: None to read. Built for in-house counsel and law firms; outputs are attorney work-product drafts.
quality_notes: Read ip-legal/oss-review (license families, deployment-model-dependent obligations, flags Commons Clause/BUSL/SSPL as not open source, routes strong copyleft to attorney), privacy-legal/dpa-review (controller vs processor playbooks, explicit jurisdiction assumption, requires citing primary sources for transfer mechanisms), commercial-legal/nda-review, product-legal/marketing-claims-review. Method-rich and conservative. US/EU framing (GDPR, US state privacy laws, USPTO-style IP); no DPDP Act, Indian Contract Act or ASCI content. Best seed for contract-review, licensing-ip, privacy and compliance-research roles, but every jurisdictional rule must be re-sourced for India.
decision_reason: Apache-2.0 and the most rigorous legal workflows found; strong guardrails (decision posture, attorney routing, citation requirements) that transfer well even though the law itself does not.

format: Claude Code subagent .md (frontmatter: name, description, color, emoji, vibe) organized by division, plus strategy/ playbooks and runbooks
tool_dependencies: Mostly none. Some agents name specific platforms (Google Ads, Salesforce, Jira, WeChat, Douyin). scripts/ contains convert.sh and install.sh (not executed).
quality_notes: Widest role coverage of any repo, uneven depth. Every file opens with a persona block (name, vibe, emoji, 'memory'); 282 files have a vibe line. Strong files contain real methods: sales/sales-discovery-coach (SPIN, Gap Selling, call structure), specialized/operations-manager (SIPOC, VSM, DMAIC), finance/finance-bookkeeper-controller (month-end close checklist), specialized/data-privacy-officer, engineering/engineering-incident-response-commander (severity matrix, runbook template), security/security-appsec-engineer (STRIDE template). Weak files: paid-media/* are 71-line capability lists; marketing/marketing-instagram-curator and marketing-growth-hacker are vibe plus generic bullets with unsourced engagement targets. Problems: overclaimed personas (finance-tax-strategist is 'Cassandra, 15+ years Big Four'), US-centric content (finance-tax-strategist covers IRS, Section 179, GILTI; specialized/hr-onboarding has I-9, W-4, 401(k), COBRA), China-specific files (specialized/recruitment-specialist is China hiring platforms and PIPL; many marketing files target Douyin, WeChat, Xiaohongshu). language-translator is Spanish-English only. Several agent names overlap with contains-studio/agents (unlicensed) but the inspected text is rewritten, not copied.
decision_reason: MIT and broadest coverage; use selectively for the method-rich files and strip personas, credentials and non-Indian jurisdiction content.

format: Claude Code plugin marketplace: 92 plugins, each with agents/*.md, skills/*/SKILL.md with references/, and commands/*.md
tool_dependencies: Mostly none for the markdown. Some plugins assume CLIs or services (Stripe, PayPal, Terraform, Kubernetes, Prometheus/Grafana); meigen-ai-design and hermes-tweet depend on third-party APIs. Repo contains Python and shell tooling and a Makefile (not executed).
paid_requirements: None for core material; some plugin integrations require paid accounts (payment processors, image generation APIs).

Read startup-business-analyst/market-sizing-analysis (top-down, bottom-up, value theory), incident-response/postmortem-writing (blameless table, triggers, timeline), hr-legal-compliance/agents/hr-pro (not-legal-advice block, ask jurisdiction first, max 3 questions), ui-design skills (visual foundations, interaction design with reduced-motion, accessibility). Agent descriptions use 'Use PROACTIVELY' in 157 files, which over-triggers. Business coverage is thin (customer-sales-automation is two short agents). Some US-default HR content (FLSA, EEOC mentions).
decision_reason: MIT, actively maintained, concrete technical skills with reference files; primary source for dev, QA, security and devops roles.

format: Agent Skills (SKILL.md with references/), 52 skills; tools/ registry of integration guides and JS CLI wrappers

Read cold-email (deliverability rules, personalization that must connect to the problem, interest-based CTAs, explicit AI-tell avoidance), influencer-marketing (disclosure section is concrete but FTC-framed; no ASCI), sms (with references/whatsapp.md covering opt-in, templates, click-to-WhatsApp ads, India named as a WhatsApp-first market). Many skills have decision tables and checklists, and some treat fetched content as data not instructions (ads/references/audit-guardrails.md). US/global SaaS framing; pricing examples in USD.

format: SKILL.md skills with references/, assets/ templates and Python CLI scripts; agents/*.md; mirrored copies for Gemini, Codex, Cursor and others in dot-folders
tool_dependencies: 745 Python files (stdlib CLI scripts for scoring, e.g. health_score_calculator.py); some skills expect Atlassian, NotebookLM or other services. Scripts not executed.

Strong pieces: business-growth/customer-success-manager references/health-scoring-framework.md (weighted dimensions with rationale), business-operations/vendor-management (when-to-use / when-not-to-use routing, scorecard), c-level-advisor/chief-of-staff (routing matrix, loop-prevention rules). Weak or risky: count is inflated by mirrors (.gemini, .codex, docs/); heavy reliance on Python scripts that a markdown-only agent cannot run; 'production-grade' claims; c-level 'advisor' personas. Provenance flag: several marketing-skill files share most lines verbatim with coreyhaines31/marketingskills (copy-editing 241 of 341 unique lines, programmatic-seo 153 of 200, ab-test-setup 151 of 197, copywriting 149 of 201) with no credit found; both are MIT, but builders should cite coreyhaines31 as the source for those topics and treat the alirezarezvani copies as derivative. last_commit_date is older than other active repos.
decision_reason: MIT and covers gaps (CS health scoring, vendor management, capacity planning, RevOps, deal desk) not covered elsewhere; use only the original, non-duplicated skills.

Read ux-researcher, legal-advisor, angular-architect: topic coverage without method. Newer short files are better (08-business-product/assumption-mapping has a VUBF risk grid and test-first quadrant). Useful as a topic checklist only.

format: SKILL.md skills with Python tools, bundles, registry, agents
tool_dependencies: Python tools, mcp-config.json (not executed).
quality_notes: Commons Clause forbids selling a product or service whose value derives substantially from the software, which conflicts with an agency selling AI-team services. Provenance flag: business-growth/customer-success-manager/references/health-scoring-framework.md matches the alirezarezvani/claude-skills MIT file in its first 30 lines, so some MIT content appears relicensed with an added restriction. README states content is AI-assisted and may contain errors. Legal and HR folders look broad (nda-review, dpia-assessment, talent-acquisition) but were not adapted.
decision_reason: Commons Clause is incompatible with commercial use; overlapping material is available from its MIT upstream.
